verdict.rationale: AWS documents rule-based automatic actions in the cost domain (e.g., AWS Budgets can auto-apply an IAM policy denying further provisioning when a threshold is hit, and budget alerts trigger on actual/forecasted spend), which is a concrete instance of 'define rules that trigger actions on events.' However the evidence pack contains no mention of AWS's core event-driven automation services (EventBridge, CloudWatch Alarms/Events, Lambda triggers, Step Functions) that would be the primary way an AI-native user builds general automatic action-on-event rules. missing for 10: EventBridge/CloudWatch event-rule automation, Lambda-triggered actions, broader general-purpose rule engine evidence beyond cost budgets.
